analysis.rationale: Structural re-interpretation: the canonical challenge generator (blind_challenge.py generate_random_pipeline) forbids a category from appearing twice (used_cats), so the global category occurs at most once per pipeline; R0's brightness+contrast (two global steps) is not generatable. A single contrast_strengthen_stretch:4 + compression_jpeg:5 reproduces all observed signals: variance_ratio=2.340 sits in the contrast_strengthen calibration range (1.84-2.74); the S-curve simultaneously explains mean_shift=+16.4 and residual_intensity_corr=0.326 (nonlinear tonal mapping, gamma_suspect); chroma_ratio=1.7192 is a consequence of per-channel stretch amplification, not an independent saturation step (YCrCb chroma-only scaling preserves luma and cannot produce +16.4 mean shift; sat_YCrCb:1+jpeg5 measured 13.04 dB, sat_HSV:1+jpeg5 10.99 dB, both rejected); block_boundary=1.759 (0%FP) is reproduced within 2% by jpeg:5 on all support pairs. Noise excluded: raw sigma=0.74, peeled sigma=1.48 on the new pipeline (<2); peeled extreme_pct=90.6% is the known structural-residual FP (sigma<5 rule). Blur excluded: spectral_slope_ratio=0.933<1.08, FFT anisotropy=0; blur_gaussian:1 insertion cost -5.25 dB in R0. Support-set validation: 28.33/31.15/28.83/27.92/26.23 dB, CI 10/10 on 5/5 pairs, +1.71 dB mean vs R0 (26.80/27.63/26.09/27.43/25.94), no pair degraded (5/5 Pareto improvement; pair1 +3.52, pair2 +2.74, pair0 +1.53, pair3 +0.49, pair4 +0.29). PSNR <40 means the exact per-pair parameterization is not reproduced (support-set variation may vary severity per pair); training PSNR arbitrates.
analysis.gate_note: Strict +2 dB gate is exceeded on 2/5 support pairs and on the mean by +1.71 (pair0 +1.53) — just below the strict +2 threshold; CHANGE taken because (a) all 5 support pairs improve, none degrade, (b) CI 10/10 on every pair, and (c) the R0 pipeline is structurally impossible under the canonical generator (two global-category steps), so it cannot be the true degradation even though its PSNR fit is only 1.7 dB lower.
analysis.blur_ruled_out: spectral_slope_ratio=0.933<1.08, FFT anisotropy=0, PCA=0; blur_gaussian:1 insertion dropped PSNR 26.8->21.55 (R0 round 19)
analysis.noise_ruled_out: raw noise_prior sigma=0.74; peeled sigma=1.48 (<2) after stripping contrast_strengthen_stretch:4,compression_jpeg:5; §B extreme_pct=90.6% is structural-residual artifact (residual std=9.8, sigma<5 rule)
signal_sources: mean_shift=+16.4 + clipped_fraction=0.1241: S-curve brightens a below-0.5-mean image
residual_intensity_corr=0.326 / gamma_suspect=True: deterministic nonlinear tonal transform
chroma_ratio=1.7192 explained by per-channel stretch, not saturation (luma-preserving)
generator structure: global category max once (blind_challenge.py used_cats) -> single global
